documents.title: Godmode Codebase Architecture
documents.raw_content: Godmode is a two-crate Rust workspace (v0.6.0) for agentic task management. godmode-core is the library containing all domain logic. godmode-cli is a thin clap binary. godmode-conformance holds property tests and benchmarks. The core data model consists of Task, TaskGraph, Status (Pending/Running/Done/Blocked), and Priority (High/Normal/Low). Tasks are persisted to .ctx/godmode/tasks.yaml. TaskGraph has a done_cache using RefCell for performance. Session owns all task state transitions, duration tracking, and trace writes. Session::start_task validates via rx before mutation. Session::complete_task records commit SHA and timing. Session::handoff writes a SessionSummary to JSONL traces. The graph module handles load/save of task files with legacy path fallback. The plan module parses markdown with Task N headings into Task structs with sequential deps. The dispatch module computes independent chains for parallel agent execution, capped at 5 concurrent. The wave module tracks parallel agent slot state. The builder module provides interactive and file-driven graph construction with shape/wire/validate phases. The detect module finds git root and reads Cargo.toml package name. The config module loads .godmode.toml or global fallback. The context module assembles SessionContext for hooks and subagents. The cache module writes StatusCache to ~/.cache/godmode/status.json for starship prompt. The verify module runs nextest + clippy + fmt + git log gate. The insights module provides append-only JSONL insight capture. The templates module resolves {{var}} substitution. The agent module parses AgentDef from agents/cfg/*.cfg.yaml paired with prompts/*.prompt.txt. The agent_index module regenerates agents/INDEX.md. The review module audits plugin conformance. The release module handles version bump, tag, push, changelog. The skill module manages skill registry install/uninstall. The registry module persists to ~/.config/godmode/registry.json. The hooks submodule contains auto_block, hook_context, pre_commit, quality_gate, stop_guard. The integrations submodule wraps external binaries: cruxx (trace Steps), doob (todo sync), hj (handoff YAML), rx (script dispatch + validation), gh (CI triage + issues), hook_migrate, hook_runner, subprocess, output, handoff_yaml. All integrations fail gracefully via .ok() so missing tools dont abort. The workflow module defines causal workflow DAGs per agent. The worktree module manages git worktree lifecycle. The scaffold module generates test stubs. The test_check module checks if .rs files have tests. The pipeline module handles pipeline execution. The report_index module provides SOLID report indexing. The memory_banking module generates .ctx/memory-bank/ context. The session_trace module provides low-level JSONL append helpers. Key dependencies: petgraph for graph algorithms, serde/serde_yaml for serialization, chrono for timestamps, clap for CLI, anyhow/thiserror for errors, slashcrux for slash-command parsing, crux-runtime for agentic runtime, tokio for async, tracing for observability. The plugin layout has .claude-plugin/plugin.json, skills/ directory, and agents/ directory with cfg/*.cfg.yaml source of truth and generated top-level .md files.
